## Description

A colourless phagotrophic euglenoid (22–81 µm, very metabolic) with a thick forward flagellum of which
only the tip beats (it glides), and an ingestion apparatus of two rods with which it swallows
*Euglena*, yeasts and whole algae. No eyespot.

## In the simulation

<!-- GENERATED:presence -->
Drops: `pond` (weight 0.15), `puddle` (weight 0.15); 4 individuals in a reference drop at weight 1.
<!-- /GENERATED -->

[Flagellar gliding](../../mechanics/locomotion.md): the rigid flagellum resting on the glass carries the cell stuck
to the substrate, straight and undragged by the water (~20 µm/s, to verify). Raptorial feeding.
[Metaboly](../../mechanics/shape-changes.md) when it stops gliding. Narrow in front, wide and truncated behind;
width estimated (~40 %).
